scope: Manual m4-context review; separate from corpus 6578. No regex extraction, upstream execution, or reference equality claimed.

entries.macroReview: Selected AT_DATA bodies and AT_CHECK expectations are literal balanced m4 quotes with no nested expansion. Container is included by i18n_utf8.at; Makefile.am selects this suite only when I18N_UTF8 is configured. The literal cobc command bypasses atlocal.in COMPILE/COBJ flags; tool mismatch must be resolved before a reference run.
entries.expectationReview: First literal uses seven Japanese BMP characters and expects the exact text without newline. The Greek case fits three two-byte UTF-8 characters into PIC N(2), demonstrating upstream byte-capacity rules, not a portable two-character rule. Truncation case expects three Japanese characters and compile warnings.
entries.frontendLimitation: CobolCS portable PIC N uses BMP character count, rejects surrogates and does not promise this UTF-8 byte-capacity ABI. DISPLAY WITH NO ADVANCING was a baseline parser defect reported separately. No upstream compiler equivalence is claimed.
entries.licenseDisposition: Top-level i18n_utf8.at GPL-3.0-or-later header; individual fragment lacks a separate header. No source or derived generated code published; inspection evidence only.

entries.macroReview: Literal AT_DATA/AT_CHECK; included by i18n_sjis.at and selected by Makefile.am when I18N_UTF8 is false. Original Japanese bytes strictly decode under Shift_JIS; original must not be read as UTF-8.
entries.expectationReview: Seven Japanese characters are expected byte-for-byte without newline in configured Shift_JIS runtime encoding. Source decoding and runtime record encoding are distinct.
entries.frontendLimitation: Current frontend configuration has no explicit Shift_JIS decode option. A separate strict decode -> UTF-8 derived input would require its own hash and offset mapping; none was evaluated. Runtime JEF/EBCDIC and Shift_JIS byte layouts are not established.

entries.macroReview: One literal AT_DATA, compile AT_CHECK with default status 0/empty outputs, then runtime AT_CHECK status 0 and four OK lines, no nested m4 macros.
entries.expectationReview: Upstream expectation is inconsistent with signed arithmetic: its comparison of -2147483648 with +2147483648 must be false. The other equality and two EVALUATE matches yield three OK lines, not four. Treat supplied expected output as an upstream characterization requiring review.
entries.frontendLimitation: Exact Number should retain signs and magnitude; a portable synthetic regression must use independently derived expected results, not copy the four-line baseline.
entries.licenseDisposition: No individual license header; do not assume root rights for extracted body. External-only.

entries.macroReview: COBJ is defined by atlocal.in as the built cobj/cobj executable. The command does not use COMPILE and therefore does not inherit FLAGS=-std=cobol2002 -debug -Wall. Literal data and 63 output lines remain in their AT_CHECK block.
entries.expectationReview: Contains P scaling, signed display and SIGN leading/trailing/separate, plus decimal presentation for V pictures. These outputs depend on the upstream display convention; preserve exact punctuation/signs/newlines rather than trimming or treating them as portable storage bytes.
entries.frontendLimitation: CobolCS source backend only accepts leading separate explicit SIGN and nonnegative scale. Unsupported P/sign/storage forms must remain review/stub cases. Portable numeric display currently uses its documented digit representation; upstream display semantics need explicit dialect decisions.

syntheticCases.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. SIGNBOUNDARY.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
IF -2147483648 < 0 DISPLAY "NEGATIVE" ELSE DISPLAY "BAD" END-IF
IF -2147483648 = 2147483648 DISPLAY "BAD" ELSE DISPLAY "DISTINCT" END-IF
IF 2147483647 + 1 = 2147483648 DISPLAY "EXACT" ELSE DISPLAY "BAD" END-IF
GOBACK.
syntheticCases.basis: Integer order, unequal opposite signs, and exact addition across signed 32-bit limit. Independently authored program; not an extracted upstream body.

syntheticCases.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. BMPTEXT.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 SHORT-NAME PIC N(3).
01 LONG-NAME PIC N(5).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MOVE "東京大阪" TO SHORT-NAME
MOVE "京都" TO LONG-NAME
DISPLAY "[" SHORT-NAME "][" LONG-NAME "]"
GOBACK.
syntheticCases.basis: Portable BMP character count: first three of four characters; two characters plus three U+0020 spaces. This explicitly differs from upstream byte-capacity/fullwidth-padding behavior.
